notes: Maximum building height in storeys above natural ground level (A2.2.1). Checked against the page 13 extract ('4 6 8 6 8 12 16 20', R80 and LR1 merged) and register rows C4P2-018 to C4P2-027. Rows also match the current names (R-AC4 = LR1, R-AC3 = MR2, R-AC1 = HR1, R-AC0 = R-PA; register C4P2-017). R-AC2 has no column and no row. The generic LR, MR and HR bands have no row (MR and HR each span columns with different values), so a site coded only LR, MR or HR is NOT_APPLICABLE until its code is known.
